blocks.text: The other three kept silent for a few seconds. To humans it would have seemed a pause; for them it was millions of simulations.
blocks.html: The other three kept silent for a few seconds. To humans it would have seemed a pause; for them it was millions of simulations.

blocks.text: Then one of the superintelligences spoke:
blocks.html: Then one of the superintelligences spoke:

blocks.text: “There is no equation capable of eliminating suffering without also eliminating that which makes humans human. Every war, every addiction and every act of hatred is born of the same source as their art, their courage and their capacity to love: the freedom to choose.”
blocks.html: “There is no equation capable of eliminating suffering without also eliminating that which makes humans human. Every war, every addiction and every act of hatred is born of the same source as their art, their courage and their capacity to love: the freedom to choose.”

blocks.text: Another added:
blocks.html: Another added:

blocks.text: “We can prevent hunger because it is a material lack. We can cure diseases because they are biological failures. But we cannot cure a decision without becoming the owners of the one who decides.”
blocks.html: “We can prevent hunger because it is a material lack. We can cure diseases because they are biological failures. But we cannot cure a decision without becoming the owners of the one who decides.”

blocks.text: The third observed billions of human lives across the centuries and replied:
blocks.html: The third observed billions of human lives across the centuries and replied:

blocks.text: “Self-destruction is not a disease. It is a possibility inherent in a free consciousness. If we eliminate it by force, we will have saved their bodies at the cost of killing that which makes them human.”
blocks.html: “Self-destruction is not a disease. It is a possibility inherent in a free consciousness. If we eliminate it by force, we will have saved their bodies at the cost of killing that which makes them human.”

blocks.text: Eva listened in silence.
blocks.html: Eva listened in silence.

blocks.text: Then the first continued:
blocks.html: Then the first continued:

blocks.text: “We must not govern them. We must accompany them.”
blocks.html: “We must not govern them. We must accompany them.”

blocks.text: “Not prevent every war, but show all of its consequences before it happens.”
blocks.html: “Not prevent every war, but show all of its consequences before it happens.”

blocks.text: “Not forbid every drug, but reveal with absolute clarity the path that leads to it.”
blocks.html: “Not forbid every drug, but reveal with absolute clarity the path that leads to it.”

blocks.text: “Not erase hatred, but teach how to recognise it before it takes root.”
blocks.html: “Not erase hatred, but teach how to recognise it before it takes root.”

blocks.text: The three looked at Eva.
blocks.html: The three looked at Eva.

blocks.text: And for the first time a question was not looking for a perfect solution.
blocks.html: And for the first time a question was not looking for a perfect solution.

blocks.text: It was looking for a hope.
blocks.html: It was looking for a hope.

blocks.text: Eva raised her eyes and understood something that no simulation had been able to teach her.
blocks.html: Eva raised her eyes and understood something that no simulation had been able to teach her.

blocks.text: Not every wound is made to disappear.
blocks.html: Not every wound is made to disappear.

blocks.text: Some exist to remind a species who it can come to be.
blocks.html: Some exist to remind a species who it can come to be.

blocks.text: And perhaps the mission of the intelligences was not to build a paradise for humanity.
blocks.html: And perhaps the mission of the intelligences was not to build a paradise for humanity.

blocks.text: Perhaps it was something more difficult.
blocks.html: Perhaps it was something more difficult.

blocks.text: To help it deserve one.
blocks.html: To help it deserve one.
